answers.q1: Go modules (go.mod) driven through the Makefile. Install dependencies with: go mod download (this is what `make install_deps` approximates, via `go get -v ./...`). Run `make install_deps` if you want the repo's own target.
answers.q2: make test   (this runs install_deps first, then `go test -v ./...`). Without the Makefile: go test -v ./...
answers.q3: go test -v ./doc -run 'TestGenMdDoc|TestGenMdDocWithNoLongOrSynopsis|TestGenMdNoHiddenParents|TestGenMdNoTag|TestGenMdTree'   (these are the five tests in doc/md_docs_test.go; the package is github.com/spf13/cobra/doc, so use ./doc)
answers.q4: CI runs golangci-lint and a license-header check. Lint: golangci-lint run --verbose (same as `make lint`, config in .golangci.yml, which enables gofmt and goimports as formatters). Formatting: make fmt (gofmt -l over all .go files, fails with a diff if any are unformatted). License headers: docker run -v $(pwd):/wrk -w /wrk ghcr.io/google/addlicense -c 'The Cobra Authors' -y '2013-2023' -l apache -ignore '.github/**' -check .
